questions.q: From which 1984 event did Spider-Man bring back his black alien costume?
questions.why: Peter got the costume in Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #8; it was later revealed to be a symbiote.

questions.q: Which artist co-created Venom with writer David Michelinie?
questions.why: David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane created Venom.

questions.q: Which reporter first bonded with the symbiote to become Venom?
questions.why: Eddie Brock, a disgraced reporter, became Venom when the symbiote bonded with him.

questions.q: Which Spider-Man villain was the main Venom host from 2005 to 2009?
questions.why: Mac Gargan, the Scorpion, took on the Venom symbiote from 2005 to 2009.

questions.q: Which former classmate of Peter Parker became Agent Venom?
questions.why: Flash Thompson served as Agent Venom from 2011 to 2016.

questions.q: Which serial killer bonds with Venom's spawn, Carnage?
questions.why: Carnage first bonded with serial killer Cletus Kasady around ASM #344.

questions.q: Which pair of things hurt the Venom symbiote?
questions.why: The symbiote is hurt by fire and high sonic waves.

questions.q: Which actor starred as the symbiote host in the 2018 Venom film?
questions.why: Tom Hardy played Eddie Brock in the 2018 Venom.

questions.q: Which actor played Venom in Spider-Man 3 (2007)?
questions.why: Topher Grace played Eddie Brock in Sam Raimi's Spider-Man 3.

questions.q: For which newspaper did the man who becomes Venom work as a reporter in the comics?
questions.why: Brock was a disgraced Daily Globe reporter before becoming Venom.

questions.q: In which Amazing Spider-Man issue did Venom make his full first appearance?
questions.why: Venom made a cameo in #299 and fully debuted in #300, in May 1988.
